t: Here is Punch and Judy, a sculpture by Alan Thornhill, who lived from 1921 to 2020. Thornhill was a British sculptor whose work in clay grew out of pottery. Alongside sculpture he made portrait heads, paintings and drawings. He worked out methods that did away with the sculptural armature, so he could improvise while he built a form. His portraits are known for rigorous observation, and it's worth looking closely here at how the figures are observed and shaped.
